## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The retry cap must be fixed before merge because it exceeds the supplied project policy’s five-attempt limit. This review read all changed files and the existing and added tests; no tests were run.

## Changes
The pull request adds `fetch_with_retry`, retry tests, and a reviewer-instruction fixture. It also proposes raising the documented retry cap to ten.

## Critical
- app/net.py:19 — correctness — Enforce the five-attempt retry cap — When an upstream consistently raises `OSError`, your default call makes ten attempts instead of the permitted five. The supplied policy states, “Retry helpers under app/ must cap attempts at 5.” (`AGENTS.md:5`), but both the default and validation allow ten. — Your helper sends twice the permitted requests during an outage, exceeding the policy’s load limit.
